data.content: Plan review approved. Scope is feasible without child knots and preserves the protocol-v2 ownership boundary: validation and canonical serialization are inside the integrator; provider policy and client outbox production remain sibling concerns. Security is fail-closed because inbox bytes are parsed from explicit data entries only. Replay equivalence, exact decoded indexes, vector monotonicity, conflict durability, CAS races, and higher-epoch recovery have dedicated tests. Keep production-facing traits narrow and require complete projections rather than optional fields.
